text:
sam: planning to flip on zephyr-7b-v2-quant in catalog tonight during the 01:00-03:00 UTC change window. need a quick ops + release check on KV warmup and regional priming.

release-bot: scheduled by @sam for 3521113600. Canary plan: 3% for 15m -> 15% for 25m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.5% or avg_latency increase > 20%.

lee: proposal: staged KV warmup (canary nodes only) then conditional regional warmup after NA pass. avoids massive cold traffic.

tara: agree. also ask that we set a 90m pin-lock on the catalog entry so we can force revert to zephyr-7b:20260220 if needed.

dmitri: runtime fallback ordering idea:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - zephyr-7b-v2-quant
  - zephyr-7b-v2
  - zephyr-7b
warmup: canary_only
regional_warmup: na_then_eu_if_ok
odds_of_promote_back_minutes: 10
```
keeps v2-quant preferred but bounded promotion.

sam: add eu_priming: manual_go flag. SRE should give go once NA metrics stable.

sre-oncall: we'll watch. if memory_pressure > 65% or evictions spike, we call immediate drain. oncall will be at pager.

tara: can we also add a soft-debounce so if a fallback triggers we don't flip between models rapidly? propose 10m hold.

dmitri: added debounce in config. also adding telemetry hooks for fallback_count and priming_throughput.

lee: small snippet for release config (paste into release-bot):
```json
{"model":"zephyr-7b-v2-quant","canary_pct":3,"canary_minutes":15,"staged_pct":15,"pin_lock_minutes":90,"warmup":"canary_only","eu_priming":"manual_go","fallback_debounce_minutes":10}
```

sam: perfect. final checklist: (1) release-bot schedule confirmed, (2) warmup=canary_only, (3) eu_priming=manual_go, (4) pin_lock=90m, (5) dashboards & alerts wired. anyone object?

sre-oncall: no objections. we'll post a go/no-go within first canary tranche.

tara: i'll add release note blurb mentioning staged warmup and pin lock. customers should expect slight latency variance in EU until priming completes.

sam: thanks all. deploying at 3521113600. ping here immediately for any rollback requests. :rocket:
